composition: Independently written Legion guidance based on the listed public documentation. Five official Google skill entrypoints were reviewed at the pinned commit for workflow inventory; their linked reference trees were not reviewed. No upstream skill content, code, payload, binaries, or executable helpers copied.

sources.supports: Contextual permission requests, rechecking access, graceful denial handling, temporary grants & process termination after revocation.

sources.title: Task scheduling

sources.title: Android Keystore system

sources.supports: Encoded recording setup order, native-resource release, hardware dependence & API-28 background microphone restrictions.

sources.supports: Initialization checks, buffer sizing limitations, read results, dead-instance recreation & native-resource invalidation.

sources.supports: App-private files, shared media via MediaStore, documents via SAF, uninstall behavior & target-dependent storage access.

sources.supports: Default backup coverage, excluded directories, legacy/current rules & distinct cloud/device-transfer settings.
